summary: Tested new company_start_date feature (backend + frontend) and confirmation that 'Configurar' button was removed from /vacations. 5/5 pytest backend tests PASSED. Frontend verified: /vacations header contains no 'Configurar'; /admin > Utilizadores > Criar Utilizador dialog pre-fills the date field with today; edit dialog renders the field with current value. Test users created during POST tests were deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2669-2715 (POST /admin/users/create): stores `plain_password` on the user document — pre-existing pattern (also in PUT L2750), but worth noting as a security-hygiene item; not introduced in this iteration.

server.py L2762-2772: PUT updates vacation_balances via upsert=True; if a user has no vacation_balance yet, csd is written but the balance doc is only partial (missing days_earned/days_taken/days_available). Consider populating full defaults, or restrict upsert. Not blocking.

AdminDashboard.jsx L1161: pre-fill only applies if createForm.company_start_date is empty ('|| today'). If admin closes the dialog after clearing the field and reopens it, today re-populates — correct behaviour.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Two temporary users (TEST_csd_default_* and TEST_csd_explicit_*) were created and deleted within the test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints validated: GET /api/admin/users enriches every user with company_start_date from vacation_balances (miguel=2023-01-15). PUT /api/admin/users/{id} accepts company_start_date and upserts vacation_balances (verified via GET). PUT without csd does NOT change balances. POST /api/admin/users/create with no csd defaults to today (verified via GET after creation); with explicit csd (2020-05-10) it persists. Frontend: /vacations header only shows 'Pedir Férias' + (admin) 'Rever'; no 'Configurar'. AdminDashboard 'Criar Utilizador' dialog auto-fills [data-testid=create-user-company-start-date] with today's date when opened (verified: value='2026-07-05' == today). 'Editar' dialog renders [data-testid=edit-user-company-start-date] with the user's current csd (or empty for users like 'pedro' who have no csd yet — this is expected).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature-add verification. Implementation matches spec across models.py (UserUpdate.company_start_date Optional[str]), server.py (enrichment, default-today on create, upsert on PUT), Vacations.jsx (Configurar button removed), and AdminDashboard.jsx (create/edit dialogs with data-testids).
